answer: Paying 26 letters of reference, each one priced at £61 is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. A seat is earned, not claimed: Fullbound journeyman vat keeper indigo writ makes sure of that, since a writ journeyman vat keepers sign after dye vat audits. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One onyx, one entry. The tally keeps quill. The willow is on the docket.
